newsitem.title: USA: Titan Wheel picks Texas for $100 mln plant.
newsitem.headline: Titan Wheel picks Texas for $100 mln plant.

text.p: Titan Wheel International Inc said Friday it has selected Brownsville, Texas, as the location for its new $100 million off-highway tire manufacturing facility.
The plant will produce tires for use in agricultural, construction and specialty applications.

At full production capacity, the Brownsville tire plant is expected to employ 500 to 700 workers and to contribute $200 to $250 million in sales for the company, Titan said. "The aftermarket tire business will provide significant growth opportunities for Titan, and we plan to develop that market and eventually be the number one manufacturer of off-highway tires in the world," said Maurice Taylor Jr, Titan president, in a statement.

Titan currently operates two off-highway tire plants. A facility in Des Moines, Iowa produces agricultural and construction tires, while a Clinton, Tenn., plant makes smaller diameter industrial, all terrain vehicle, trailer and grounds care tires.
